offer.what_we_sell: Pipewell, a tool that watches LinkedIn and company data for buying signals (competitor engagement, hiring, funding, posts about outbound problems) and tells sales reps which accounts to contact this week
offer.problem_it_solves: Sales development teams spend most of their time prospecting accounts that are not in-market, so outbound reply rates and meetings booked keep falling

icp.target_companies: B2B software companies that run outbound sales
